field: cognitive science of language, mind and grounding
public_contact_or_submission: public contact form, newsletter and community listserv
why_relevant: interdisciplinary body spanning AI, linguistics, psychology, neuroscience, philosophy and education; publishes the official Cognitive Science journal and topiCS
notes: use the public contact form or the opt-in listserv; no personal emails

public_contact_or_submission: research papers via PCS; symposia, workshops and tutorials via OpenReview
why_relevant: double-blind 6-page papers must relate to the study of the mind; a ground-visible venue for a shape claim with a refuter
notes: submissions open 2026-11-20, close 2027-02-01; check current dates; symposia proposals are peer reviewed and should present differing perspectives

public_contact_or_submission: self-subscribe through the public listserv page
why_relevant: opt-in distribution of announcements and job postings to the cognitive science community; members post themselves
notes: opt in only; do not use as a bulk send channel for an unreviewed claim

field: language and cognition interface, sensorimotor simulation, iconicity, multimodality, language evolution
why_relevant: official journal of the UK Cognitive Linguistics Association; explicitly welcomes empirical work on sensorimotor simulation, multimodality and language evolution, all bears on grounded meaning
notes: open access; submission requires a separate ScholarOne account; generally does not consider applied classroom or language-teaching work

field: computational linguistics, NLP, language model evaluation
public_contact_or_submission: public contact page and public events listing
why_relevant: the venue of the Bender and Koller 2020 paper on form versus meaning; ACL runs the main computational linguistics conferences and SIGs
notes: use the public contact route; the /portal/contact link appears on the homepage but was not separately opened

organization: First Workshop on What LLMs Can(not) Do
public_contact_or_submission: workshop call listed in the ACL events feed
why_relevant: a public, field-specific venue whose scope directly includes what text-only models cannot do; listed on the ACL homepage as a latest event
notes: seen in the ACL events listing; the call page itself was not separately fetched; check the current deadline before submitting

public_contact_or_submission: public paper records and PDF access
why_relevant: open record of Bender and Koller 2020, the strongest public statement that a system trained only on form has no way to learn meaning; useful for locating the checkers who work this question
notes: an archive, not a contact point; included as a route to the relevant literature and reviewer community

public_contact_or_submission: self-submission through the public arXiv submission system
